description: Canonical Maya CLI commands with implementation status and discovery guidance.

commands.name: maya ask <command...>
commands.description: Run one command through Maya's in-process agent loop.
commands.whenToUse: Use for the legacy in-process brain path.

commands.name: maya browser click <text...>
commands.description: Click the shared Playwright page by text, accessible role, or CSS selector.
commands.whenToUse: Use for a focused click after navigating or reading the shared browser page.

commands.name: maya browser navigate <url>
commands.description: Navigate the shared Playwright page and return its title and ARIA snapshot.
commands.whenToUse: Use to open a URL in Maya's shared persistent browser context.

commands.name: maya browser read
commands.description: Read the shared Playwright page as a bounded ARIA snapshot.
commands.whenToUse: Use to inspect the current shared browser page without a screenshot.

commands.name: maya browser screenshot --out <path>
commands.description: Capture the shared Playwright page to a requested PNG path.
commands.whenToUse: Use for a focused browser capture; JSON output includes path and dimensions.

commands.name: maya browser type <text...>
commands.description: Type into a browser field or CSS selector and optionally submit.
commands.whenToUse: Use with --field or --selector to enter text into the shared browser page.

commands.name: maya capabilities
commands.description: Return the deterministic, versioned CLI command contract.
commands.whenToUse: Use when an agent needs Maya's complete current CLI contract.

commands.name: maya docs index [--check]
commands.description: Regenerate or validate the local docs indexes deterministically.
commands.whenToUse: Use after changing mapped commands, tools, files, or documentation.

commands.name: maya docs query <query>
commands.description: Search indexed Maya documentation and return focused matches.
commands.whenToUse: Use when an agent needs design or workflow context rather than implementation.

commands.name: maya doctor
commands.description: Report core install, config, agent skill, and optional desktop dependency health.
commands.whenToUse: Use before debugging Maya or when you need a deterministic install and dependency report.

commands.name: maya files map [query]
commands.description: List important repository files and responsibilities from the curated index.
commands.whenToUse: Use before repository exploration to avoid broad scans.

commands.name: maya find <query>
commands.description: Search curated file, tool, doc, and command indexes with bounded output.
commands.whenToUse: Use to locate the smallest relevant Maya context before opening source files.

commands.name: maya live <command...>
commands.description: Run one in-process agent command with the WebSocket overlay bridge.
commands.whenToUse: Use for the legacy visual agent path, not the MCP server.

commands.name: maya mcp
commands.description: Start the MCP stdio server.
commands.whenToUse: Use as the current MCP server launch command.

commands.name: maya ping
commands.description: Verify the Anthropic key using a small model request.
commands.whenToUse: Use to test the legacy Anthropic provider configuration.

commands.name: maya proc list
commands.description: List background processes managed by Maya across CLI invocations.
commands.whenToUse: Use to discover process ids before reading logs or stopping a managed command.

commands.name: maya proc logs <id>
commands.description: Read a bounded tail of a managed background process log.
commands.whenToUse: Use after proc start or proc list to inspect recent process output.

commands.name: maya proc start <command...>
commands.description: Start a long-running command with persistent metadata and captured output.
commands.whenToUse: Use for dev servers, watchers, or other commands that must outlive one CLI call.

commands.name: maya proc stop <id>
commands.description: Stop a managed process group by its persistent id.
commands.whenToUse: Use to terminate a process started through maya proc start.

commands.name: maya serve
commands.description: Start the optional MCP stdio server while preserving maya mcp compatibility.
commands.whenToUse: Use to launch Maya's optional MCP server; maya mcp remains a compatibility alias.

commands.name: maya setup [claude|codex]
commands.description: Install or refresh Maya's generated agent skill; pass --with-mcp to also register the optional MCP server.
commands.whenToUse: Use to install or refresh Maya's generated agent skill, or add --with-mcp when an agent still needs MCP registration.

commands.name: maya start
commands.description: Start the Maya daemon, with optional --no-overlay.
commands.whenToUse: Use for the legacy always-running voice/overlay path.

commands.name: maya status
commands.description: Show Maya daemon status.
commands.whenToUse: Use to inspect whether the legacy daemon is running.

commands.name: maya stop
commands.description: Stop the Maya daemon.
commands.whenToUse: Use to stop the legacy daemon.

commands.name: maya terminal run <command...>
commands.description: Run a focused shell command through shared safety, audit, timeout, and output behavior.
commands.whenToUse: Use only after the CLI action adapter preserves current MCP safety and auditing.

commands.name: maya tool call <tool-name> [input]
commands.description: Execute any active registered tool through the shared safety and audit wrapper.
commands.whenToUse: Use as the generic parity path when no curated CLI command exists.

commands.name: maya tool describe <tool-name>
commands.description: Return exactly one active tool's description and JSON input schema.
commands.whenToUse: Use when an agent needs one full tool contract instead of the complete MCP catalog.

commands.name: maya tool list
commands.description: List active tool names and concise summaries in deterministic order.
commands.whenToUse: Use for lightweight capability discovery.
